Frozen BEFORE the self-validation is run against known-bad/known-good cohorts and BEFORE any of the 5 parked candidates are re-scored -- no re-picks of the regime definition, the split rule, or the pass/kill bar after seeing results. Runner: backtest/tools/regime_classifier.py + backtest/tools/regime_conditioned_validator.py + backtest/tools/regime_conditioned_self_validation.py. Added a new disclosure this repo did not have: applying the method's VIX-band half to the go-live gate's own evidence window (automation/state/core-decisions.jsonl, 2026-08-26..2026-09-02) shows LOW/MID bands only (0 HIGH), consistent with go-live-gate.json's own calm-only regime_coverage disclosure. The TREND half of the label could not be computed for any of those 6 dates or for 269/403 (67%) of the full real trade record -- the frozen daily-SPY trend cache (analysis/backtests/cache/trend-alignment-spy-daily-2024-07-01_2026-07-14.json) is stale past 2026-07-14 and was NOT extended (would require re-deriving daily bars from intraday data, forbidden by this file's own classifier spec) -- disclosed as a genuine capability gap, not an engine finding. Full report: analysis/harness-fidelity/REGIME-CONDITIONED-VALIDATION-2026-09-03.{json,md}. No params/heartbeat/live file touched; no_ship_clause holds.
standing_doctrine: The methodology is on trial, not the candidates (ANTI-METHODOLOGY-SHOPPING SAFEGUARD, non-negotiable). Regime-conditioning may NOT adjudicate a single live candidate until it first correctly KILLS every known-bad reference cohort AND correctly PASSES every known-good reference cohort, using the EXACT SAME gate ladder / split rule / thresholds this file freezes. If it passes any known-fake, the verdict is REJECT-METHODOLOGY -- calendar-WF stands, interpretation (A) recency-overfitting holds, and NONE of the 5 parked candidates get re-adjudicated this task.
the_question: 5+ studies all park on INSUFFICIENT_REGIME_SHIFT (negative 2025 IS-delta / positive 2026 OOS-delta under calendar WF). Is that (A) recency-overfitting (the 2026 edges are curve-fit to recent tape) or (B) genuine regime break (2026's market character differs structurally from 2025, so calendar-year is the wrong reference class)? This study tests whether a regime-CONDITIONED validator can honestly discriminate real edges from noise -- if it can, it earns the right to answer (A) vs (B) for the 5 parked candidates; if it cannot, the honest answer is (A) by default (the parked studies' own calendar-WF verdict stands).

vix_band.source: automation/state/params.json#vix_iv_regime_bands (the live premarket context-tagging ladder; params.json _vix_section: "iv_regime bands (LOW/MID/HIGH) used by premarket for context tagging"). Deliberately NOT vix_entry_thresholds -- params.json's own _vix_entry_thresholds_doc discloses that ladder is VESTIGIAL, not read by the live order-placing path.
vix_band.definition: LOW: vix_close < 15.0. MID: 15.0 <= vix_close <= 22.0. HIGH: vix_close > 22.0.
vix_band.causal_rule: Band is computed from the PRIOR trading day's final 5-minute VIX close (the last row of backtest/data/vix_5m_2025-01-01_2026-07-08.csv dated strictly before the target date). Same-day VIX data is NEVER used to label that day (C6, zero lookahead).

trend_character.source: crypto/lib/market_structure.py#analyze_structure + classify_trend (Trend = uptrend/downtrend/range/unknown), invoked BYTE-IDENTICAL to setup/scripts/context_bundle_producer.py#_tf_state()'s live daily-timeframe call -- the function feeding the live context bundle's trend_alignment.per_tf.daily field (compute_trend_alignment's own docstring: "AS-OF-BOUNDED and pure ... zero look-ahead (C6) and zero re-derivation of the math").
trend_character.window: DEFAULT_WINDOW = 2 (bars-per-side fractal), identical to context_bundle_producer.py's call.
trend_character.lookback: trailing 190 calendar days of DAILY SPY bars (context_bundle_producer.py _fetch_bars("1Day", days_back=190, limit=200)), capped at 200 bars.
trend_character.causal_rule: Only daily bars strictly BEFORE the target date are used (the target date's own session is excluded). Data source: analysis/backtests/cache/trend-alignment-spy-daily-2024-07-01_2026-07-14.json (the SAME cache context_bundle_producer.py's live daily fetch populates/reads -- pre-existing, not re-derived).

regime_classifier.regime_label: vix_band + '_' + trend (e.g. MID_uptrend, HIGH_downtrend). Empirically 6 buckets are populated over 2025-01-02..2026-07-08 (verified by smoke-running the classifier before this freeze): HIGH_downtrend, HIGH_uptrend, LOW_uptrend, MID_downtrend, MID_uptrend, UNKNOWN_downtrend (the single boundary date with no prior VIX row). No LOW_downtrend/*_range dates occurred in this window -- disclosed, not engineered.

regime_conditioned_validation_procedure.input_contract: A candidate is a population of dated (date, pnl) episodes. pnl is ALREADY the candidate-minus-control delta the caller intends: for a standalone 'take these trades' cohort, control=skip so delta=raw trade pnl; for a block/gate candidate, the caller passes the REMOVED cohort with pnl negated (delta = -pnl(removed), the same sign convention elite_bear_level_reject_gate_ab.py already uses) -- documented per call site, never assumed silently.
regime_conditioned_validation_procedure.target_regime_bucket_rule: MODAL regime bucket among the candidate's own tagged episodes (ties broken by alphabetically-first bucket name). This RULE is fixed here BEFORE any candidate is scored; which bucket a given candidate resolves to is discovered by running it, not chosen post-hoc to fit a desired answer.
regime_conditioned_validation_procedure.split_rule: Within the target regime bucket ONLY, sort ALL of that bucket's episodes (across the full 2025-01-02..2026-07-08 window, both years) by date ascending. First half (n//2) = regime-IS, second half = regime-OOS. This is a CHRONOLOGICAL split within the regime, not a calendar-year split -- the mechanism that removes the calendar confound while keeping a genuine held-out check.
regime_conditioned_validation_procedure.minimum_data_requirement: Target bucket needs >= 6 episodes total AND >= 2 on each side of the split, else verdict = INSUFFICIENT_N (distinct from FAIL -- the method declines to adjudicate rather than force an answer on too little data). A bucket with zero 2025 representation cannot, by construction, be checked against 2025 data -- both_years_present_in_bucket is reported for every candidate regardless of verdict.
regime_conditioned_validation_procedure.wf_formula: WF_delta = (mean regime-OOS delta) / (mean regime-IS delta) -- WF-GATE-METHODOLOGY-2026-07-16.md's Option B formula, applied within-regime instead of within-calendar-year. Same verdict ladder: is_delta_mean>0 & WF_delta>=0.70 -> PASS; is_delta_mean>0 & WF_delta<0.70 -> FAIL; is_delta_mean<=0 & oos_delta_mean<=0 -> FAIL; is_delta_mean<=0 & oos_delta_mean>0 -> INSUFFICIENT_REGIME_SHIFT (a candidate that only works in the newest slice of its OWN regime bucket is STILL not proven -- this catches recency-within-regime, not just recency-by-calendar).
additional_gates: sub_window_stability: regime-IS and regime-OOS each split in half again chronologically; both halves' mean pnl must be >=0 for 'stable' (skipped/auto-pass when a side has <4 episodes -- too thin to sub-split meaningfully).
bh_fdr: one-sided test (mean regime-OOS pnl > 0) at alpha=0.10, single-candidate (degenerates to a plain threshold, disclosed not hidden -- same convention as elite_bear_level_reject_gate_ab.py).
concentration_check: drop the top-3 |pnl| episodes from regime-OOS; the remaining mean must stay >0 (fable-too-good hunt, built in not bolted on).
regime_conditioned_validation_procedure.tautology_disclosure: For every candidate, report the % of its target regime bucket's episodes dated 2026. Threshold: >=90% (or <=10%, i.e. near-total concentration in one calendar year) sets degenerate_regime_proxy_flag=true. A candidate that would otherwise PASS is relabeled PASS_BUT_DEGENERATE_REGIME_PROXY and does NOT count as a clean earn-rights signal -- passing only because the target regime happens to be a calendar-year proxy is the exact failure mode this whole exercise exists to catch.
regime_conditioned_validation_procedure.global_tautology_check: Independently of any candidate, compute the regime-label x calendar-year contingency table and Cramer's V over the FULL 2025-01-02..2026-07-08 trading-day universe (backtest/tools/regime_classifier.py#tautology_stats). Reported once, disclosed in the scorecard regardless of self-validation outcome.

pass_kill_criteria_for_the_method_itself.earns_rights_iff: ALL FOUR known-bad cohorts resolve to a verdict in {FAIL, INSUFFICIENT_REGIME_SHIFT, INSUFFICIENT_N} (never PASS or PASS_BUT_DEGENERATE_REGIME_PROXY) AND the vwap_continuation known-good cohort resolves to PASS (PASS_BUT_DEGENERATE_REGIME_PROXY counts as a disclosed partial pass, not a hard method failure, but is flagged) AND the OP-16 anchor qualitative check shows no coverage/regression problem.
pass_kill_criteria_for_the_method_itself.fails_iff: ANY known-bad cohort PASSES cleanly (methodology-shopping proven) OR the known-good vwap_continuation cohort is KILLED (FAIL or INSUFFICIENT_REGIME_SHIFT -- over-strict, not better) OR the OP-16 anchor qualitative check reveals the classifier cannot even coherently label J's own anchor dates.
pass_kill_criteria_for_the_method_itself.on_fail: Verdict = REJECT-METHODOLOGY. Calendar-WF (WF-GATE-METHODOLOGY-2026-07-16.md) stands unchanged. Interpretation (A) [recency-overfitting] holds as the honest default for the 5 parked candidates. NONE of them are re-scored under this method this task -- re-scoring after a failed self-validation would itself be the methodology-shopping this file exists to prevent.
pass_kill_criteria_for_the_method_itself.on_earn_rights: Re-run backtest/tools/regime_conditioned_validator.py against each of the 5 parked candidates' own removed/candidate cohorts (re-derived from their existing A/B study scripts, sign convention per candidate type), report which flip from INSUFFICIENT_REGIME_SHIFT to PASS under regime-conditioning and which do not. A flip changes EVIDENCE STATUS ONLY -- see no_ship_clause.
